body.p: This listing of claims replaces all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A method of obtaining a stiffness of a gear of a joint on a robotic arm, where the joint is connectable to at least one other joint on the robotic arm, where the joint comprises a motor having a motor axle, where the motor axle is configured to rotate an output axle through the gear, and where the method comprises:
applying torque to the motor axle using the motor, where applying the torque to the motor axle results in rotation of the motor axle and the output axle;
obtaining an angular position of the motor axle;
obtaining an angular position of the output axle, anddetermining the stiffness of the gear based on at least the angular position of the motor axle, the angular position of the output axle, and a dynamic model of the robotic arm, where the dynamic model defines a relationship between forces acting on the robotic arm and resulting accelerations of the robotic arm.
2. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein determining the stiffness of the gear is based also on the torque applied to the motor axle.
3. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein applying the torque to the motor axle results in movement of at least a part of the robotic arm.
4. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein determining the stiffness of the gear comprises:
obtaining a deflection of the gear based on the angular position of the motor axle and the angular position of the output axle; and
obtaining a flexibility torque of the gear at the deflection of the gear based on at least the angular position of the motor axle, the angular position of the output axles and the dynamic model.
5. (Original) The method of claim 4, wherein determining the stiffness of the gear comprises repeating operations comprising:
applying new torque to the motor axle using the motor;
obtaining a new angular position of the motor axle;
obtaining a new angular position of the output axle;
obtaining a new deflection of gear based on the new angular position of the motor axle and the new angular position of the output axle; and
obtaining a new flexibility torque of the gear at the new deflection of the gear based on at least the new angular position of an motor axle, the new angular position of output axle, and dynamic model; and
for each repetition, storing the new deflection of the gear and the new flexibility torque of the gear at the new deflection of the gear.
6. (Original) The method of claim 5, wherein determining the stiffness of the gear comprises fitting, to a mathematical function, flexibility torques and deflections of the gear obtained by repeating the operations.
7. (Original) The method of claim 6, wherein the mathematical function comprises a polynomial function obtained based on a recursive least squares estimation.
8. (Original) The method of claim 6, wherein the stiffness of the gear is based on a slope of the flexibility torques relative to the deflections of the gear.
9. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising:
comparing the stiffness of the gear with prior knowledge of the stiffness of gear; and
providing a status of the gear based on a result of the comparing.
10. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the dynamic model comprises information modeling a parallel spring and damper coupling between the motor axle and the output axle.
11. (Original) The method of claim 1, where the robotic arm comprises joints including the joint comprising the gear, where a combination of the joints are for connecting a base and a tool flange, and wherein the method further comprises:
controlling the joint based on the dynamic model and the stiffness of the gear.
12. (Original) The method of claim 11, further comprising:
modifying the dynamic model based on the stiffness of the gear.
13. (Currently Amended) A system comprising a robotic arm, the system comprising:
joints in the robotic arm, a combination of the joints connecting a base and a tool flange;
at least one controller to control the joints based on a dynamic model of the robotic arm;
at least one of the joints comprising a motor having a motor axle, the motor axle being configured to rotate an output axle via a gear, where the dynamic model defines a relationship between forces acting on the robotic arm and resulting accelerations of the robotic arm; and
wherein the at least one controller is configured to obtain a stiffness of the gear by performing operations comprising:applying torque to the motor axle using the motor, where applying torque to the motor axle results in rotation of the motor axle and the output axle;
obtaining an angular position of the motor axle;
obtaining an angular position of the output axle; and
determining the stiffness of the gear based on at least the angular position of the motor axle, the angular position of the output axle, and the dynamic model, where the
dynamic model defines a relationship between forces acting on the robotic arm and resulting accelerations of the robotic arm.
14. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the at least one controller is configured to control the at least one of the joints based on the stiffness of the gear.
15. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the torque applied to the motor axle causes movement of at least part of the robotic arm.
16. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the robotic arm comprises at least one of:
an output encoder to indicate the angular position of the output axle; or an input encoder to indicate the angular position of the motor axle.
17. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the at least one controller is configured to perform operations comprising:
comparing the stiffness of the gear to a threshold value; and
providing a status signal relating to the gear based on the comparing.
18. (Original) The system of claim 13, further comprising:
